key_insight: A two-stage contrastive training pipeline—"Mine" then "Refine"—produces semantic embeddings that capture graded relevance (exact matches, substitutes, complements) at scale, improving multi-category e-commerce search retrieval robustness for long-tail and noisy queries.
problem_solved: E-commerce retrieval needs embeddings that generalize to long-tail, noisy queries while respecting scalable supervision and product/policy constraints; existing approaches struggle to represent graded relevance where users accept substitutes or complements beyond exact matches.
method: Mine: gather large-scale, scalable supervision (weak/silver positives and negatives across categories) suitable for production constraints.
Refine: contrastive fine-tuning that explicitly models graded relevance, separating exact matches, substitutes, complements and true negatives in embedding space.
End-to-end design prioritizes scalability and compatibility with product/policy requirements so embeddings can be deployed across multi-category search systems.
impact: Provides a practical way to train embedding models that better rank items for nuanced user intent in production search systems—improving relevance for long-tail queries while remaining scalable and policy-aware.
